title: Detection expansion: ten sequential experiments
status: In progress: rounds 1-9 completed, including retained failures and a separately registered partial audio follow-up. Round 10 whole-app evidence pending.
purpose: Improve observable Start and Finish localization and correctly accepted endpoints. Implementation, test coverage and additional abstentions do not by themselves establish better detection.
ownership: Independent evaluator maintains this summary; runtime changes and native processing belong to their assigned agents.

baseline.groupingLimit: The six existing phone recordings do not establish six independent climbers or sessions.

fixedEvaluation.frozenAtStage: Before any candidate result in this new expansion sequence is scored.
referenceEligibility: Match original source hash, physical event definition and observed lane or athlete region.
Retain two separately frozen prediction-blind observer worksheets and their conservative union where available; agent observation is not a human study.
Do not substitute body launch for recorded cue arrival, apparent pad contact for indicator reversal, or either for calibrated electronic timing.
A known wrong physical patch fails identity qualification even if its timestamp happens to be close.
Freeze source group, target attempt, search window, settings, intended inputs and one primary result before candidate predictions; keep guided reruns separate.
Keep disputed, unobservable, missing, failed and automatically accepted but unverified events visible.
fixedEvaluation.policyMeaning: A prospective comparison policy, not a physical measurement-error guarantee.
fixedEvaluation.disagreement: For prediction p and reference union [L,U], report signed interval [p-U,p-L].
fixedEvaluation.verifiedWithinPolicy: The matching-event signed interval must lie entirely within [-0.100,+0.100]. A straddling interval is indeterminate.

localizationEvidenceScore.numerator: Designated displayed or proposed primary cue matches the physical event and its entire disagreement interval satisfies policy; acceptance is not required.
localizationEvidenceScore.denominator: All prospectively qualifying reference events in the declared stratum, including missing proposals and failures.
localizationEvidenceScore.noQualifyingReference: null, with a reason; never fabricate an accuracy value.
localizationEvidenceScore.interpretation: Scoped benchmark localization performance, not general detector accuracy or overall evidence strength.

automaticEndpointEvidenceScore.numerator: Original automatic output, matching physical event and lane, satisfying the same full-interval policy.
automaticEndpointEvidenceScore.denominator: The same qualifying-reference events, including reviews, failures and missing outputs.
automaticEndpointEvidenceScore.noQualifyingReference: null, with a reason; raw coverage cannot supply the missing labels.
automaticEndpointEvidenceScore.interpretation: Scoped verified automatic yield. A review-only improvement receives no automatic recovery credit.

strata: Start and Finish reported separately, with counts and reference definitions.
Default whole-app automatic runs separate from guided search, manually selected lane and manually supplied Start.
Conditional automatic Finish given a reviewed Start/lane is not an end-to-end automatic pair.
Real original recordings separate from synthetic controls and correlated derivatives; copies do not add attempts.
Previously exposed development sources separate from any genuinely untouched whole-source holdout.

safetyGate.passCondition: No newly known wrong-event, wrong-lane or beyond-policy automatic acceptance in the frozen controls; preserve existing invalid-cue, cancellation and source-ownership rejection.
safetyGate.consequence: Reject or retain as research-only a variant that violates the gate regardless of its average score.
safetyGate.limit: A finite control pass is not a population false-acceptance estimate.

latency.metric: Selection of Run to the first useful accepted result or actual review/error terminal.
latency.requiredForSpeedClaim: At least three counterbalanced baseline/candidate passes with exclusive queue, matching browser/build/source/settings and equivalent work.
latency.notEquivalentWork: Skipping Finish or returning earlier because a new guard blocks work cannot establish faster detector throughput.
latency.helperTimings: Report separately as helper CPU measurements; never substitute for whole-app latency.

fixedEvaluation.decisionRule: Complete each round using actual retained evidence, assess safety and scoped outcome, then record feedback before the next round. Rejected and no-gain experiments are valid recorded outcomes; proposed work is not a completed round.
fixedEvaluation.amendmentRule: Keep initial plans and failed evidence. Record a dated amendment and reason before any amended candidate result; do not silently replace primary denominators.

primarySources.title: World Climbing competition rules linked from the official resources page
sections: Definitions: Reaction Time and Starting Signal
primarySources.finding: The rules distinguish the starting signal from starting-pad force release and define a successful speed Finish by stopping the timer through a hand strike on the pad.
primarySources.application: Recorded light, acoustic arrival, visible body motion and apparent pad contact retain distinct event labels. The official electronic reaction rule does not calibrate visible body-motion delay.

primarySources.title: W3C Web Audio API 1.1
primarySources.finding: Stereo-to-mono speaker mixing averages left and right samples. Decoding may resample PCM to the context rate.
primarySources.application: Frequency-local cancellation is a plausible mechanism, not independent timing truth. Preserve native channel hashes, actual sample rate, extraction frames and clock origin; do not count channels as separate evidence sources.

primarySources.title: SciPy ShortTimeFFT documentation
primarySources.finding: Window length, hop, FFT size and centered time labels are distinct parameters; boundary windows can extend beyond input support.
primarySources.application: Smaller hops or extra zero-padding do not establish precise event onset. Record leading versus centered timestamps, window support, padding and fallback uncertainty before comparing clocks.

primarySources.title: WICG requestVideoFrameCallback draft specification
primarySources.publicationStatus: Draft Community Group Report; not a W3C Standard
primarySources.finding: mediaTime identifies the presented frame's media PTS. Callback delivery is best effort and can lag or miss frames.
primarySources.application: Associate pixels with native PTS and available duration, not requested seek time or callback wall time. Retain duplicate, missing-frame and incomplete-tail limitations.

primarySources.title: Google MediaPipe Pose Landmarker for Web
primarySources.finding: The task outputs pose landmarks, supports a configurable number of poses, and its image/video detection calls run synchronously.
primarySources.application: A pose is not named-athlete identity. Compare full-frame and cropped results on the same native pixels, map crops back correctly, retain multiple-person ambiguity and measure actual processing cost.

primarySources.title: SciPy find_peaks documentation
primarySources.finding: A local peak depends on neighboring sample values; plateau handling and prominence are distinct from selecting the largest value within a restricted band.
primarySources.application: A target-band edge can be the shoulder of an out-of-band peak. Prospective research should inspect adjacent spectral bins outside the band and preserve legitimate plateau cases; documentation alone does not validate a detector change.

rounds.title: Audio gain and noise robustness
rounds.question: Measure stability under registered amplitude and background-noise perturbations of hashed native PCM.
requiredEvidence: Freeze deterministic gains, noise seeds, noise levels, peak/clipping policy and original clock mapping.
Report source-by-condition outcomes; include wrong-protocol and no-cue negative controls and retain raw baseline behavior.
rounds.decisionCriterion: Preserve correct cue identity and clocks where signal remains qualified; added noise or clipping must not create a new wrong automatic protocol.
rounds.nextFeedback: Use failures to define a separate channel, phase and sample-rate experiment without retuning this grid after results.
rounds.scoreReason: Localization score is a correlated source-condition robustness score on one development recording, not accuracy across distinct attempts. Automatic-endpoint score is N/A because these reports exercise the audio kernel, not app acceptance.
rounds.decision: Retain unchanged audio and record robustness limitations; no automatic recovery or general accuracy gain.
rounds.feedbackAfterActualResult: All five gain conditions retain 8.590 s, but all three additive-noise conditions fall back to Medium at 7.230-7.240 s outside the recorded-cue bracket. Next stress channel balance, phase and resampling, with no threshold relaxation or new channel votes.
rounds.actualScope: Audio-kernel robustness on transformed copies of six existing native-PCM sources. Timing score is confined to derived conditions of the one source with an eligible recorded-cue bracket; High is not whole-app automatic acceptance.
